en.k3d: 2 strength · 3 hikes · 1 swim · Garmin-only (no Hevy volume)
en.eNote: No meals logged for Jul 22 – Jul 28 (last intake log: Jun 14), so the energy and burn charts assume the 2,000 kcal plan. Garmin active burn averaged ~466 kcal/day — the highest weekly average in a month — peaking 817 on Saturday's double day (lift + 4.9 km hike) and 702 on Wednesday's 7.1 km hike. Only Friday (70 kcal) was a true rest day; Tuesday (Jul 28) is just starting, with hack squat planned.
en.bNote: Net exercise = Garmin active calories; standing BMR 2,414. Intake assumes 2,000 kcal all seven days (none logged after Jun 14), so the implied balance ≈ −880 kcal/day is exercise-driven, not measured. Tuesday (Jul 28) just starting.
en.wNote: Bridge shows the last logged meals (Jun 12–14) — no intake was logged for the displayed week. Negative balance = deficit.
en.i1t: The biggest week in a month — driven by hiking, not the gym
en.i1: 6 sessions across 5 active days, 6h40 and ~3,264 active kcal — well up on the 4 sessions and 3h30 of the last snapshot. Three Zagreb hikes carry it: 7.1 km Wednesday, 4.9 km Saturday on top of a lift, 7.0 km Sunday, 19 km on foot in total. Wednesday's planned swim intervals were swapped for the hike; everything else followed the plan. Friday was the only full rest day.
en.i2: Thursday's squat ran 57 min at avg HR 112 (max 151) for 474 kcal; Saturday's trap-bar deadlift 57 min at avg HR 105 (max 136) for 411 kcal — the lighter of the two, and it was followed the same day by a 52-min hike. Neither is in Hevy, so tonnage and per-set HR peaks are missing for both and the lift names come from the weekly plan, not the log. The last logged lift remains Jul 21's hack squat: 13,480 kg, 160 kg × 10 for three working sets.
en.i3t: Monday's pool intervals were the week's hardest single effort
en.i3: The 2.2 km set (10×100 / 10×50) ran 65 min at avg HR 129, max 155, for 759 kcal — the highest average HR and the biggest single-session burn of the window. It was also the only swim: with Wednesday's intervals traded for a hike, pool volume stopped at 2.2 km against a plan of two swim days.
en.i4: This morning HRV dropped to 37 — the window's lowest and 8 below the 45 average — with RHR up to 55, the window's highest, the morning after Monday's intervals. Sleep answered with depth rather than length: 6h23 total off a 23:49 bedtime, but 123 minutes of deep sleep, far beyond any other night in the window, and only 13m awake. Score 77. Sunday evening has no sleep record at all, so the chart runs Mon 20 → Mon 27 with Sun 26 skipped.
en.rec: Tuesday's plan is hack squat, and it should go ahead — but at maintained load, not a new top set. The week behind is the heaviest in a month (6 sessions, 6h40, ~3,264 active kcal, 19 km hiked), and this morning is the first time the markers have pushed back: HRV 37 against a 45 average, RHR 55 at the window high, off a 6h23 night whose 123 minutes of deep sleep read as recovery being spent. Repeat Jul 21's 160 kg × 10 rather than adding, and keep the accessories as logged. Next: hack squat today, swim intervals Wednesday, squat Thursday, rest Friday. Wednesday's swim is the one to protect — it has now been swapped out two weeks running, and it is the session that keeps the aerobic side honest.

hr.k3d: 2 snage · 3 planinarenja · 1 plivanje · samo Garmin (nema Hevy volumena)
hr.eNote: Nema zabilježenih obroka za 22.7. – 28.7. (zadnji unos: 14.6.), pa grafovi energije i potrošnje pretpostavljaju planskih 2.000 kcal. Garmin aktivna potrošnja prosj. ~466 kcal/dan — najviši tjedni prosjek u mjesec dana — vrhunac 817 na subotnjem dvostrukom danu (trening snage + 4,9 km planinarenja) i 702 na srijedinom usponu od 7,1 km. Samo je petak (70 kcal) bio pravi dan odmora; utorak (28.7.) tek počinje, s planiranim hack squatom.
hr.bNote: Neto trening = Garmin aktivne kalorije; standardni BMR 2.414. Unos pretpostavlja 2.000 kcal svih sedam dana (ništa zabilježeno nakon 14.6.), pa je implicirana bilanca ≈ −880 kcal/dan posljedica treninga, ne mjerena. Utorak (28.7.) tek počinje.
hr.wNote: Most prikazuje zadnje zabilježene obroke (12.–14.6.) — za prikazani tjedan nema unosa. Negativna bilanca = deficit.
hr.i1t: Najveći tjedan u mjesec dana — nose ga planine, ne teretana
hr.i1: 6 treninga kroz 5 aktivnih dana, 6h40 i ~3.264 aktivnih kcal — znatno više od 4 treninga i 3h30 iz prošlog snimka. Nose ga tri zagrebačka uspona: 7,1 km u srijedu, 4,9 km u subotu povrh treninga snage, 7,0 km u nedjelju — ukupno 19 km pješice. Srijedini planirani bazenski intervali zamijenjeni su planinarenjem; sve ostalo je pratilo plan. Petak je bio jedini potpuni dan odmora.
hr.i2t: Dva dana snage, oba samo na Garminu
hr.i2: Četvrtkov čučanj trajao je 57 min uz prosj. puls 112 (maks 151) i 474 kcal; subotnje trap-bar mrtvo dizanje 57 min uz prosj. puls 105 (maks 136) i 411 kcal — lakši od dvojice, a istoga dana slijedio je uspon od 52 min. Nijedan nije u Hevyju, pa nedostaju tonaža i vrhovi pulsa po seriji, a nazivi vježbi dolaze iz tjednog plana, ne iz zapisa. Zadnji zabilježeni trening snage ostaje hack squat od 21.7.: 13.480 kg, 160 kg × 10 u tri radne serije.
hr.i3t: Ponedjeljkovi bazenski intervali bili su najteži pojedinačni napor tjedna
hr.i3: Set od 2,2 km (10×100 / 10×50) trajao je 65 min uz prosj. puls 129, maks 155 i 759 kcal — najviši prosječni puls i najveća potrošnja pojedinačnog treninga u prozoru. Bilo je to i jedino plivanje: uz srijedine intervale zamijenjene usponom, bazenski volumen stao je na 2,2 km naspram plana od dva plivačka dana.
hr.i4: Jutros je HRV pao na 37 — najniže u prozoru i 8 ispod prosjeka od 45 — uz RHR na 55, najviše u prozoru, jutro nakon ponedjeljkovih intervala. San je odgovorio dubinom, a ne duljinom: ukupno 6h23 uz lijeganje u 23:49, ali 123 minute dubokog sna, daleko iznad svake druge noći u prozoru, i samo 13m budnosti. Ocjena 77. Nedjelja navečer uopće nema zapisa sna, pa graf ide od Pon 20 do Pon 27, uz preskočen Ned 26.
hr.rec: Utorak po planu donosi hack squat i treba ga odraditi — ali na zadržanom teretu, bez nove najteže serije. Tjedan iza najteži je u mjesec dana (6 treninga, 6h40, ~3.264 aktivnih kcal, 19 km pješice), a jutros su pokazatelji prvi put uzvratili: HRV 37 naspram prosjeka od 45, RHR 55 na vrhuncu prozora, uz noć od 6h23 čijih se 123 minute dubokog sna čitaju kao trošenje oporavka. Ponovi 160 kg × 10 od 21.7. umjesto da dodaješ, a pomoćne vježbe drži kako su zabilježene. Sljedeće: hack squat danas, bazenski intervali u srijedu, čučanj u četvrtak, odmor u petak. Srijedino plivanje treba zaštititi — već je drugi tjedan zaredom zamijenjeno, a upravo ono drži aerobnu stranu poštenom.
